itinerary.title: The Giza plateau
itinerary.source: The first day goes straight to Giza, because the plateau is where most people's idea of Egypt was formed and where it either holds or deepens.

itinerary.title: The Grand Egyptian Museum
itinerary.source: The second day belongs to the collection.

itinerary.title: Saqqara and Old Cairo
itinerary.source: The third day reaches back past Giza to the very beginning of monumental stone construction, then forward to Cairo's older inhabited layers.

itinerary.title: The Citadel and the bazaar
itinerary.source: The final day belongs to medieval Cairo before the airport transfer.
